metadata.source: African Journals Online (AJOL) on-site public search
metadata.purpose: Source-level retrieval, query-lineage, and canonical-identity audit
limitations: Citation metadata only; abstracts/full text were not copied.
Twelve missing pages caused by repeated browser navigation captures were re-opened and validated through the normal AJOL interface.
Canonical matching used compact DOI first, then exact normalised title plus year; no bridge conflicts were found.
Outside-window flags are deterministic date checks, not substantive eligibility decisions.
metadata.qa_trust_level: High for URL/query lineage and canonical identity linkage; insufficient for substantive eligibility screening because abstracts were not captured.
